cards.label: King's Cross
cards.text: The departures board changes its mind for the fourth time. Somewhere behind the barriers, a Tannoy voice apologises for something it clearly isn't sorry about.
Everyone's on the King's Cross deal. You are, for once, one of the delayed rather than the delighted.

choices.label: Wait it out
choices.result_text: You wait. Time passes the way it only does in stations — all of it, somehow, at once.

choices.label: Pay for a cab (£30)
choices.result_text: You pay. The driver has opinions about the Northern line. You did not ask for them.

cards.text: Either way, you get where you're going. King's Cross remains, structurally, on its way somewhere else.
